Stop consuming a required option value and treat --partition=all_debug as a switch: fixed expected False is violated; both role lists are literal and independent of production sets.
Stop consuming a required option value and treat -prigel as a switch: fixed expected False is violated.

Delete an option from the production role set or stop after consuming its value: the genuine subsequent partition no longer produces fixed expected True; this catches omissions that refusal-only checks would miss.
Consume a following token for --nice or -k, reject valid attached required values, or stop processing short flags before p: the relevant literal case produces False rather than fixed True.

Ignore unknown roles before/after a partition, keep the first partition after an empty override, scan inside flag/optional values, or scan past a script: a literal refusal case produces True rather than fixed False.
